Diabetic Meal Ideas
🌅 Breakfast: Oatmeal with nuts, or eggs with vegetables — avoid sugary cereals.
🌞 Lunch: Grilled protein + non-starchy vegetables + a small portion of whole grains.
🌙 Dinner: Similar to lunch, lighter portion — avoid large carb-heavy meals late at night.
Diabetic Foot Care Checklist
👣 Check feet daily for cuts, blisters, or redness.
🧦 Wear well-fitting shoes and clean, dry socks.
🚿 Wash and dry feet (especially between toes) daily.
🩺 See a doctor promptly for any sore that isn't healing.
Insulin / Medication Reminder
Hypo / Hyperglycemia Guidance
📉 Low sugar (below 70 mg/dL): Have 15g fast-acting sugar (juice, glucose tablets), recheck in 15 min. Seek help if confusion or fainting occurs.
📈 Very high sugar (above 250 mg/dL): Drink water, avoid extra carbs, take medication as prescribed. Seek urgent care if vomiting, confusion, or breathing changes occur.

🥗 Simple Diet Tips

🍎 Fill half your plate with vegetables and fruit at each meal.
🧂 Reduce added salt — a major driver of high blood pressure.
🚶 Aim for at least 30 minutes of walking most days of the week.
💧 Drink water before meals — it helps with portion control.

Diet Plans by Need

⚖️ Weight lossCalorie deficit, more protein & fiber
💪 Weight gainCalorie surplus, strength training
🩸 Diabetic-friendlyLow glycemic-index carbs
🫀 Heart-healthyLow salt, low saturated fat
🤰 Pregnancy nutritionExtra folate, iron, calcium — ask your doctor
🧒 Child nutritionBalanced meals, limit sugary snacks
👴 Elderly nutritionEnough protein & calcium, easy to chew

🧘 Mood Tracker

🌬️ Breathing Exercise

Try this simple technique when stressed or anxious:
1️⃣ Breathe in slowly through your nose for 4 seconds
2️⃣ Hold your breath for 4 seconds
3️⃣ Breathe out slowly through your mouth for 6 seconds
4️⃣ Repeat 4–5 times

🚑 Injury — what to do

1️⃣ Stay calm. Check if the person is breathing and conscious.
2️⃣ For heavy bleeding: press a clean cloth firmly on the wound.
3️⃣ Do not move someone with a suspected neck/back/head injury unless necessary for safety.
4️⃣ Call your local emergency number immediately (see below) or get to the nearest hospital.
5️⃣ If possible, note down what happened, any medicines the person takes, and known allergies to tell hospital staff.

❤️ Basic CPR Guide (adults)

1️⃣ Check responsiveness — tap and shout. Call for emergency help.
2️⃣ Place heel of hand on center of chest, push hard and fast (about 2x/second).
3️⃣ Continue chest compressions until help arrives or the person responds.
This is a simplified overview — proper CPR training (e.g. a local first-aid course) is strongly recommended for everyone.

♻️ Recycling & Sustainability

🔄 Reuse Idea Finder

Tell Declan what you have, and get upcycling/DIY ideas.

🌍 Recycling Categories

♻️ PlasticBottles, containers — rinse before recycling
📦 Paper & CardboardKeep dry, flatten boxes
🍾 GlassRinse, remove lids
🔋 E-waste & BatteriesNever bin — take to a collection point
👕 TextilesDonate wearable clothes, repurpose the rest
Exact rules vary by country/city — check your local municipal guidelines for specifics.

🥗 Reduce Food Waste

🧊 Freeze leftovers before they spoil.
📝 Plan meals around what's already in your pantry (check the Kitchen tab).
🥕 Use vegetable scraps for stock instead of throwing them out.

🌱 Sustainable Shopping

🛍️ Bring reusable bags when shopping.
📦 Choose products with less packaging when possible.
🔁 Buy secondhand/refurbished for electronics and furniture where practical.

🌍 Carbon Footprint Tips

🚗 Combine errands into one trip, or walk/bike for short distances.
💡 Switch to LED bulbs and unplug devices not in use.
🥩 A few meat-free days a week meaningfully lowers your household's footprint.
🌡️ Adjusting your thermostat by even 1-2 degrees saves noticeable energy over a month.

🔒 Privacy & Security

Where your data lives
Everything you enter (pantry, bills, health readings, documents, etc.) is stored locally on this device in your browser. If you use Family Share, that data also syncs to Declan's cloud database so your family sees the same information — each household's data is kept separate by a private household code, but as with any app's backend, Declan's operator has the same technical access to that database that any service provider does. Nothing is sold or shared with third parties.
AI features
When you use AI features (Ask Declan chat, photo analysis, Symptom Checker, recipe suggestions), the relevant text/photo is sent to Google's Gemini API to generate a response. It is not stored by this app beyond your device/your own cloud.
Family Sharing
If you share your family code with someone, they can access your household's synced data. Only share it with people you trust.
Your control
You can export, or permanently clear, all your data anytime from Data & Storage below.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I get AI features working?▾
Ask your app developer to set the GEMINI_API_KEY on Netlify. Without it, Declan uses simplified offline demo responses.
Is my data safe?▾
Yes — see Privacy & Security above for full details on where your data is stored.
How do I sync with my family?▾
Go to Family Sharing in your Profile, copy your code, and have your family member paste it under "Join a family member's home".
